subject: Culture
title: Embargoes and Sanctions
description: A micro-lesson that makes Embargoes and Sanctions usable.

hook.text: Russia banned European food imports in 2014. Cheese became contraband. Customs crushed smuggled Brie.

buildup.text: Food embargoes punish nations by restricting what their citizens can eat. The table becomes a front line.

discovery.text: Cuba's embargo forced the island to reinvent its agriculture. Urban farms bloomed from necessity.

twist.text: Sanctions often hurt ordinary people while leaders eat fine. The weapon is blunt and indiscriminate.

climax.text: Blocking food trade is blocking identity. When the cheese disappears, something cultural dies too.

punchline.text: An embargo doesn't just empty shelves. It isolates souls.

quiz.question: How did Cuba respond to the US food embargo over time?
